title: Generalized Unitary Coupled Cluster Wave functions for Quantum Computation
venue: Journal of Chemical Theory and Computation
problem_summary: Introduces k-UpCCGSD, a unitary coupled-cluster ansatz built from a family of sparse generalized paired-doubles operators, offering an affordable, systematically improvable alternative to full UCCSD suitable for near-term quantum hardware.

components.family_or_name: k-UpCCGSD (k-fold unitary paired-coupled-cluster generalized singles and doubles)
components.notes: Sparse generalized-doubles operator family, systematically improvable by increasing k.

workflow_composition_notes: k-UpCCGSD is a drop-in ansatz replacement for standard UCCSD within the ordinary VQE loop, trading a tunable k parameter for accuracy vs. circuit depth.
